onboarding.title: Welcome to Bloom
onboarding.subtitle: Your cycle, your body, your rhythm.
onboarding.intro: Lyra never sees your cycle data unless you turn it on. Always your call.
onboarding.stepBirthHint: Helps us understand your stage in life — peri-/menopause windows, etc.
onboarding.stepLastPeriod: When did your last period start?
onboarding.stepLastPeriodHint: Best guess is fine. You can change it later.
onboarding.stepCycleLength: Roughly how many days between periods?
onboarding.stepCycleLengthHint: If you don't know, leave 28 — we won't predict until we have more data.

today.needsOnboardingSub: Tell us a few things to start tracking.

phaseSummary.menstrual: Your period is here. Estrogen and progesterone are at their lowest. Be gentle with yourself.
phaseSummary.follicular: Estrogen is rising. Energy and mood often lift through this week.
phaseSummary.ovulation: Estrogen peaks; LH triggers release. Many feel social, focused, more confident.
phaseSummary.luteal: Progesterone is dominant. Late this phase, mood and energy may dip — this is biology, not failure.

predictionWithheld.no-data: Tell Bloom when your last period started to begin tracking.
predictionWithheld.not-enough-data: I'll start predicting after a few cycles. Honesty over false confidence.
predictionWithheld.irregular: Your cycles seem irregular — I won't guess. Logging helps you see your own patterns.

today.quickLogSoon: Daily logging arrives in the next update.
today.markPeriodConfirmBody: I'll record today as the start of a new cycle. You can undo this later.

calendar.hint: Tap a day to view · Long-press to mark period start
